construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation written for this isolated build

input.fixtures: Each URL has retrieved_at and either body/content_type or redirect_to. All data must be synthetic.

output.provenance: Source ID, canonical requested/final URLs, complete redirect chain, supplied timezone-aware retrieval timestamp, SHA-256 of original UTF-8 body, SHA-256 and retained normalized text. Findings cite source ID, final URL, retrieval timestamp, body hash, exact quote and zero-based exclusive-end normalized-text character offsets.

shared_schema.validation: Shared Validator handles schema, exact-host URL allowlisting, fixture contracts, retrieval bounds and output citation integrity. Unknown input fields and duplicate JSON fields are rejected.

cross_stage_handoffs: Validated URLs and normalized fixture map -> bounded fixture-only retrieval
Retrieved response and redirect chain -> HTML/plain-text extraction with retained provenance
Normalized text and query tokens -> exact extractive findings -> output reference validation
behavior: No network code or live providers; retrieval resolves solely from supplied synthetic fixtures.
HTTPS only, exact ASCII DNS host allowlist, default/443 port only; no credentials, fragments, wildcard/subdomain matching, IP literals or control characters.
All fixture and redirect URLs are validated, including unused fixtures; redirect cycles and more than five redirects fail.
Duplicate canonical requested URLs collapse in original order; duplicate fixture URLs fail. Different requested URLs ending at the same final URL retain separate provenance.
HTML scripts, styles, noscript and templates are excluded; basic block boundaries and entities are normalized.
Case-insensitive exact word matching produces sentence-like excerpts in request/text order, not factual inference or query answering.
Missing fixtures and validation errors fail atomically. Zero matches succeeds with a warning; max_findings truncates with a warning.
No wall-clock dependence. Fixture timestamps are supplied claims, and hashes establish content identity, not source authenticity.
CLI prints one JSON object; success exits 0 and input/file/retrieval errors exit 2.

included: Synthetic HTML and plain-text retrieval fixtures
Bounded input size, fixture count, body length, redirect count and findings
Deterministic evidence extraction and provenance validation
excluded: Live HTTP/DNS, search engines, crawling, robots compliance and retries
LLM execution or optional provider integration
Browser rendering, PDF parsing, semantic ranking and fact verification
Full browser HTML parsing semantics and CSS visibility
Production hosting, persistence, authentication and enterprise delivery

test_outcomes.cli_result: One JSON object with status ok, two sources and two provenance-preserving findings
test_outcomes.error_cli_checks: Usage, missing file, directory input, malformed/duplicate-key JSON, invalid encoding, invalid schema and oversized input returned status error with exit code 2
